why: Two pseudopotential bugs found and fixed: the all-electron atom's far density wasn't converged (exchange left a tail that skewed α Z by ~1 Ha·bohr³ per ion, a 1/V error), and in 4D the ion's leaked moment missed the pseudo-valence's ⟨r²⟩ deficit (α Z grew without bound). θ − corundum went from +1.53 to +0.69 eV per formula (PySCF with the same functional +0.58). Now: the four aluminas at four scales, ecut 40; all eight Bl₂Px₃ candidates at Γ (soft, ecut 25); the top two at 4 shifted k.
